description: This file defines a class VectorStorePreCallHook that manages pre-LLM call hooks for vector store searches, including extracting queries from messages, appending search results as context, and integrating search results into responses and streaming chunks.

classes.name: VectorStorePreCallHook
classes.description: A custom logger class that handles vector store searches before LLM calls, appending relevant context to messages and integrating search results into responses.

methods.name: async_get_chat_completion_prompt
methods.description: Performs vector store search, extracts query from messages, and appends search results as context to messages before LLM call.

methods.name: _extract_query_from_messages
methods.description: Extracts the search query from the last user message in the message list.

methods.name: _append_search_results_to_messages
methods.description: Appends search results as context to the message list.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_deployment_hook
methods.description: Adds search results to the response after a successful LLM call.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_deployment_hook
methods.description: Adds search results to the final streaming chunk.
